pattern: Generated cards tend to give themselves away by framing rather than object design. The evidence is modest, since no pair scored above confidence 3. The hero may be pushed to an extreme of scale: it nearly fills the card (saloon, backpack, beach ball), or it shrinks into a low band or inside its setting (sneakers, wreath on door). Scenes also pick up extra props and busy surroundings that compete for the first read at thumbnail size (planter tools, plant pot beside the book, ivy around the door, glossy slab under the scroll). Real cards keep one clear hero at a moderate scale on a simple backdrop. When they crop, the crop is deliberate and affects only the hero's base or a backdrop element.
